# AMP Email Gallery

> Interactive field guide to AMP for Email on CleverTap. 72 template prototypes across
> 9 industry verticals, each with a feasibility rating and extractable AMP4Email production
> code. Part of an eighteen-guide series covering the full CleverTap channel and platform
> stack. Maintained by SJ Neo, Enterprise Customer Success Manager, CleverTap APAC.

URL: https://shijunneo-bot.github.io/amp-email-gallery/
Series hub: https://shijunneo-bot.github.io/ct-gallery-hub/

## Key facts

- AMP for Email lets recipients interact inside the inbox: forms, carousels, live data.
- AMP for Email renders through SendGrid. Other routes deliver the standard HTML version.
- AMP requires the Email Booster Max or Advanced Email add-on on the CleverTap plan.
- Rendering clients: Gmail, Yahoo Mail, Mail.ru, FairEmail. Others receive the HTML part.
- AMP content expires 30 days after receipt. Forwarded messages show the HTML version.
- Form submissions route through @SpecialLinks and land as a CleverTap event.
- Every AMP email ships with an HTML fallback for clients that do not render AMP.
- The page has a day and night theme, defaulting to night, remembering the reader's choice.

## Sections

- AMP Gallery: 72 prototypes with Green, Amber, and Red feasibility ratings. Green works
  with standard AMP components. Amber needs backend infrastructure. Red is conceptual,
  with suggested workarounds using supported components. Each template has Copy HTML and
  Download, which return a clean AMP4Email document ready to paste into CleverTap.
- Award Journeys: a DBS journey builder walkthrough.
- Partner Stack: the five partner layers an email passes through. Design (Stripo, Alpaco,
  Email Love, Taxi for Email), Validate (Clearout, Kickbox), Enrich (Movable Ink,
  NiftyImages, Sendtric, Litmus, Mailmodo and others), Localise (Crowdin, Lokalise),
  Deliver (SendGrid, Amazon SES, Postmark, Mandrill, Gmail, Generic SMTP). The delivery
  layer determines whether AMP renders.

## The series, grouped by plan tier

Advanced plan: Rich Push, Custom HTML In-App, Native Display, App and Web Inbox, Webhooks,
  Linked Content, Geofencing, Bulletins.
Cutting Edge plan: Recommendations and Catalog.
Add-ons: Product Experiences, Reminders, Promos, AMP Email (Email add-on),
  SMS and RCS (SMS add-on), WhatsApp (WhatsApp add-on).
Platform: Trust and Security, Intelligence and Activation.

Full index and links: https://shijunneo-bot.github.io/ct-gallery-hub/
